draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.43, the 22nd-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 3rd of 36 at CB. He went 30th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Tyson Campbell. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (98th percentile). Testing concerns: 10-yard split (6th percentile). College production: 6 passes defended in 2023, 18th of 34 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Baltimore Ravens. 32 career games and 23 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 5 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: passes defended 14 (93rd percentile), season snap share 90.7% (92nd percentile), interceptions 3 (92nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 cornerback who played: 90.7% season snap share against a median of 27.8%, above the norm.
